kind: Actual ScreenChart and MaterialDialog React components; original Modal and Impact buttons in jsdom; chart and DataGrid renderer hosts are semantic stand-ins

checks.name: Actual ScreenChart removes the redundant default date-button cloud and keeps exact interval actions inside its collapsed data alternative
Keyboard-focusable chart-data row action emits its exact interval ID and preserves controlled selection state
Production chart click and zoom-selection callbacks remain intact with exact week sets and the original actual/LY palette
Actual MaterialDialog portals the original shared Modal and exact ItemThumbnail preview classes, and opening an image does not navigate
Original Modal focus trap, Escape close and trigger focus restoration work through the real image-preview component
Original backdrop close and explicit Close work independently; only Open item performance requests the separate item route

limitations: No native Chrome or pixel-layout assertion.
Highcharts rendering and AG Grid layout are not exercised; the production callback/options and accessible row renderers are exercised.
The original Modal visibility helper receives a jsdom-only offsetParent fixture because jsdom has no layout engine.
